command: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== TIMER/RUNLOOP INDEX ==='; grep -nE 'function (schleife|atmen|drift|driften|kopfWeiter|kopfRoll|koerperSchritt|gazeSchritt|mikroSakkade|blinzeln|hgSchritt)|requestAnimationFrame\(|setInterval\(|setTimeout\(' buehne.html | tail -180; echo '=== MAIN LOOP ==='; L=$(grep -n 'function schleife' buehne.html | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); if [ -n "${L:-}" ]; then S=$((L-35)); E=$((L+90)); nl -ba buehne.html | sed -n "${S},${E}p"; fi; echo '=== ATEM ==='; L=$(grep -n 'function atmen' buehne.html | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); S=$((L-20)); E=$((L+95)); nl -ba buehne.html | sed -n "${S},${E}p"; echo '=== MIKROSAKKADE ==='; L=$(grep -n 'function mikroSakkadeSchritt' buehne.html | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); S=$((L-18)); E=$((L+55)); nl -ba buehne.html | sed -n "${S},${E}p"; echo '=== GAZE BASE ==='; L=$(grep -n 'function gazeBasisSichtbar' buehne.html | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1); S=$((L-12)); E=$((L+48)); nl -ba buehne.html | sed -n "${S},${E}p"
